output.reason: A few days of right-hand numbness and tingling worse at night, with reported absence of weakness, facial droop or speech change, fits a common nerve-compression pattern that can start with self-care plus a clear action-based safety net.
output.patientMessage: You can start with self-care: avoid sleeping with the wrist bent, try a neutral wrist splint at night, and ease repetitive wrist tasks. Night-worse hand tingling often comes from nerve compression at the wrist. Seek urgent care if you develop hand weakness, dropping things, or constant loss of feeling. Call 911 immediately for sudden face droop, arm weakness or speech trouble.
differential: Carpal tunnel syndrome (median nerve compression at wrist)
